description: Four-input XOR gate with a separate logical inverter, polyphonic; a voltage over 2V counts as high and stays high until it falls below 0.1V

params.text: Lit, the XOR output goes high only when exactly one input is high; unlit, it goes high whenever an odd number of the inputs are high

inputs.text: The first of the four inputs into the XOR; with nothing patched here the XOR output stays at 0V, and the number of channels patched here sets the polyphony
One of the four inputs into the XOR; an unpatched input counts as low
The signal fed to the inverter; with nothing patched here the inverter is fed the XOR result instead

outputs.text: 10V when an odd number of the four inputs is high, or when exactly one is high with ONE-HOT lit; 0V otherwise
The logical inverse of what the inverter is fed: 10V when that is low, 0V when it is high. With the I input empty this is the XNOR of the four inputs
